description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the IDGeneratorDao component within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods such as getCurrentID and updateNextId on entities like Employee, Module, and User.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the IDGeneratorDao methods, focusing on current ID retrieval and ID updating for specific entity classes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of IDGeneratorDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetCurrentID
methods.description: Tests that getCurrentID returns expected starting values for Employee, Module, and User entities.

methods.name: testUpdateNextId
methods.description: Tests updating the next ID for Employee entity and verifies the current ID reflects the change.
